name: Antigravity CLI (agy -p)
role: opt-in executor. Not selected unless --backend agy (alias --backend gemini) is passed, or "agy" is listed in routing.default_order
binary_resolution: OPENSWARM_AGY_BIN, else agy on PATH, else ~/.local/bin/agy
quota_source: none (unknown). Token usage is read from the result envelope after the run, not used for routing
steerSupport: abort-and-resume: the running process is killed and the conversation is resumed with the steer text
streaming_events: NDJSON stream-json lines: init, step_update and a result envelope (conversation_id, status, response, error, usage)
never: reading anything under ~/.gemini or other credential stores
